responsibility: VxWorks crtbegin variant that integrates GNAT EH-frame registration with the kernel module loader’s automatic constructor processing. It reuses the common vx_crtbegin registration bodies, then publishes _ctors and _dtors arrays containing the registration and deregistration routines so loaders configured for automatic C++ constructor strategy will execute them. This file therefore owns the array-based startup/shutdown hookup, not the underlying frame-registration code.
